usage: cox runs land [-h] --repo REPO [--task TASK] [--phase PHASE] [--label LABEL] [--force]
                     [--no-claim] [--worktree-root WORKTREE_ROOT] [--apply] [--no-merge]
                     [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--profile PROFILE]
                     run_id

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --task TASK
  --phase PHASE         land the whole phase off its own epic branch instead of one task
  --label LABEL
  --force               land despite a foreign live leader
  --no-claim            land without taking an unheld or stale loop
  --worktree-root WORKTREE_ROOT
  --apply
  --no-merge
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   override: resolve task records here instead of the profile's workspace_dir
  --profile PROFILE
